lines.zh: 我压低身子，一步一步逼近
lines.en: I lower myself and close in, step by step.
My antlers arrive before my body.
My hoofprints sink into the frozen soil.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷气里成白雾
lines.en: My breath fogs in the cold.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在雪上没声音
lines.en: My hooves make no sound on the snow.
I shorten the gap step by step.
I press my head down low.
I circle, hunting an angle.
I stop and coil my legs.
I come at you in a straight line.

lines.zh: 我撞开一丛挡路的枝条
lines.en: I plough through a stand of branches.
In the tree shadows, I follow.
I press forward along the ground.
I stand, shoulders heaving.

lines.zh: 骨头一样的东西从我背上长出来
lines.en: Bone-like things grow from my back.

lines.zh: 我在听你胸腔里的跳动
lines.en: I am listening to the beat in your chest.

lines.zh: 我的头低着，角朝着前面
lines.en: My head is low, antlers forward.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，比树更像树
lines.en: Still, I look more like a tree than a tree does.
Snow settles layer by layer on my back.
I wait for you to take the first step.

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪上是黑的
lines.en: My shadow is black on the snow.
My head comes up by degrees.

lines.zh: 我的嘴里有热气冒出来
lines.en: Steam comes from my mouth.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见我的骨头响。
lines.en: So quiet I can hear my bones.
I have said nothing.
I count the times you breathe out.
I am looking for a seam in you.

lines.zh: 刚才那声音你听见没有
lines.en: Did you hear that sound just now?
Both your hands tremble.
Whatever you do, do not look back.
My antlers point at your chest.

lines.zh: 你已经在我撞得到的距离
lines.en: You are already within my charge.
I know your scent.
Run or raise your shield. Choose.
Those tracks in the snow are yours.
I followed them here.
The trees will not save you.
I have no need to roar.
I will not miss this time.
I give half a pace in the snow.
Something struck my bone.
That impact hurt dully.
My antlers are slightly askew.
My four legs are still under me.
I am putting that on my account.
I can charge once more.

lines.zh: 冲撞被打断，鹿角都歪了。
lines.en: My charge broke off, and even my antlers are crooked.
I will not touch that.
What I eat runs on its own.

lines.zh: 你把手里的东西举起来干嘛
lines.en: What are you lifting that for?
Keep it; I am not hungry.
I sniff and turn my head.
My eyes are fixed on you.
Do not let your hand shake.
I will not even look at it.
That is far too small.
It is you I would rather have.
Throw it well away.
I am still closing in, step by step.
My antlers have not moved once.
I do not intend to take anything.
I barely gave ground.
You are knocked backward.
Your foot is on my hoof.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，雪都飞起来
lines.en: We collide, and snow flies.
I put out a hand and shove you.
That should tell you something.

lines.zh: 我的骨头碰到你的骨头
lines.en: Bone meets bone.
Do not press your whole body on me.
Not at a time like this.
I only want to knock things over.
Do not ask about such things.
I need no one.
I turn my head aside.
The bone on me is still growing.
There is only food here.
I breathe out a cloud of white.
I come closer still, step by step.
I shake my head slowly.
I do not look at what falls in the snow.
I push it aside with my antlers.
I tramp it down into the snow.
Whose it is, I do not care.
I kick it aside.
It is in my path.
I scrape it away.
I want none of these.
I have finally found you.
This is me lowering my head.
I begin to gather my strength.
You are in my charge line.
The snow tells me where you are.
I begin counting from one.
My antlers are the answer.
There are only trees behind you.
I saved this charge a long time.
I lower my antlers and gather force.
I lower myself and close the gap.
I gather force. The next step is the charge.
I am working out the angle.
The snow is deep; you cannot run fast.
My breathing grows louder.
I count the remaining distance.
Turn, and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我始终贴在你视线边上
lines.en: I stay just at the edge of your vision.
I slam my whole body into you.
My antlers bite your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我全部的力
lines.en: That took everything I had.
My own head is ringing.
I butt you again.
You go down into the snow.
Snow scatters under me.
There is blood on my antlers.
That charge will slow you for a while.

lines.zh: 雪地上多了一个很高的影子
lines.en: A tall shadow joins the snow.
I rise up from behind the trunk.
I walk through the snow, step by step.

lines.zh: 我背上的骨头又长了一点
lines.en: The bone on my back has grown a little.
The snow is deep here.

lines.zh: 冲撞之前，我先呼出一口白气。
lines.en: Before the charge, one breath of white.
I hear someone near.
I come around a tree.
Snow hangs on my antlers.
I slowly arch my back.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的毛，焦味很重
lines.en: Fire singes my hide, and the stench is heavy.
I roll down the snowy slope.

lines.zh: 泥水从我鼻孔里灌进去
lines.en: Muddy water pours into my nostrils.
The blast throws me into the snow.

lines.zh: 魔法烧着我背上的骨头
lines.en: Magic burns the bone on my back.

lines.zh: 雷劈在雪地上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes the snow and I shudder.

lines.zh: 我脚下的雪一下消失了
lines.en: The snow under me vanishes.
